summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Italian Professional Accounting & Legal Export Engine' (Export & Sync drawer) on the preview URL. Flow: synthetic Italian invoice PNG (/tmp/fattura_export.png with P.IVA 00743110157, imponibile 1.500,00, IVA 22% 330,00, totale 1.830,00) -> upload -> model-gemini -> analyze-btn -> results OK (16-18 fields, 3 audit checks) -> export-sync-btn opens export-drawer. Verified: gdpr-badge visible ('Elaborazione senza conservazione - File non salvato'), export-category default = 'invoice' (correct for an invoice), field-mapping renders 25 editable inputs with dynamic testids (map-supplier.piva, map-supplier.codice_fiscale, map-customer.piva, map-document.number/date/type, map-totals.*, map-vat_lines.0.*, map-iban, map-line_items.0.*). Live validation: P.IVA 00743110157 -> valid-ok, 12345678901 -> valid-bad, CF MRTMTT25D09F205Z -> valid-ok, AAAAAA00A00A000A -> valid-bad; typing char-by-char (delay 40-60ms) does NOT reset the input (value preserved). Downloads all verified via page.expect_download: Fattura_FatturaPA.xml, Fattura_TeamSystem.xlsx, Fattura_TeamSystem.csv (filenames include selected software), docuanalytics-export.json, executive-summary.pdf (14.4 KB, jsPDF). Edited mapping value ('9999,99' in map-totals.imponibile) correctly present in the exported JSON. exp-fatturapa enabled with category=invoice and correctly disabled after switching export-category to 'other'. close-export closes the drawer; backdrop click closes it only inside the (mis-sized) overlay area. ZERO console errors and zero pageerrors across the whole run.

ui_bugs.issue: The overlay is NOT full-viewport: an ancestor <section class="fade"> has transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) (fade animation), which becomes the containing block for position:fixed. Measured drawer-bg rect = x:380 y:72 w:1160 h:1101 on a 1920x1080 viewport, so (a) the drawer is not flush to the right edge and its height overflows the viewport (1101 > 1080, bottom content/tmpl-note pushed off-screen), (b) the header and the left/top page area are not dimmed and remain clickable, (c) clicking the page background outside that box (e.g. 20,20) does NOT close the drawer (click at 400,600 inside the box does close it). Fix: render the drawer in a React portal to document.body, or remove the transform/will-change from the animating ancestor while a drawer is open.

issues: Because of the containing-block bug the drawer floats mid-page instead of being a right-edge sheet; bottom action area (PDF button + tmpl-note) can be cut off at 1080px height.
Field mapping list uses max-height:34vh with inner scroll: only ~8 of 25 rows are visible, no visual hint that the list scrolls.

action_items: Fix .drawer-bg fixed-position containment (portal the drawer to document.body) so the overlay covers the full viewport, the sheet is flush right, and backdrop click closes it anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: ExportDrawer.fieldKind (App.js ~1054) only validates paths ending in 'piva' / containing 'codice_fiscale' / 'piva_cf'. Paths like 'piva_iva', 'partita_iva' or f24/visura schemas using different key names would silently skip validation - consider a broader regex.
flattenObj keys the mapping rows by path only; if an array element is removed/reordered by a re-analysis the input state could mismatch. Low impact today (arrays are read-only in the UI).
downloadServer swallows the error (`catch { notify(export_fail) }`) without logging the server response - hard to debug real 4xx/5xx from the export endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 8 requested scenarios pass except full-viewport backdrop close)

seed_data_creation: Anonymous sessions with 3 free credits; 3 analyses of /tmp/fattura_export.png (synthetic Italian invoice PNG generated by /app/tests/make_invoice.py).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export & Sync drawer fully functional: all 5 export formats download correctly, live CF/P.IVA validation works, mapping edits persist into exports, category gating of FatturaPA works. Only remaining defect is the CSS/portal containing-block issue on .drawer-bg (overlay not full viewport => backdrop click outside the box does not close). Use state='attached' when set_input_files on [data-testid=file-input] (input is hidden).
rca_of_the_issue: position:fixed on .drawer-bg is resolved against the nearest ancestor with a transform; the results <section class="fade"> applies a transform via its fade-in animation, so the overlay is sized/positioned relative to that section instead of the viewport.
